project_type: Python FastAPI monorepo with backend at apps/backend/
build_system: pip-compile (requirements.in -> requirements.txt with hashes). Dockerfile at apps/backend/Dockerfile. No Makefile.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), conftest.py for fixtures, APP_ENV=test, mocks for Redis/MongoDB
build_command: pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt (or docker build for validation)
verification_instructions: Run pytest from apps/backend/ directory. Tests mock all external services. No real MongoDB/Redis needed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: requirements.txt is generated from requirements.in via pip-compile --generate-hashes. Do NOT regenerate it - just update requirements.in for new deps.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. google-cloud-aiplatform is already in requirements.in. numpy is NOT in requirements but can be added to requirements.in.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: Beanie Document models, singleton service instances, async/await throughout, unittest.mock for tests
key_patterns: 1) Models use Beanie Document with Settings.name for collection. 2) Services are singletons (e.g., content_publisher_service, search_service). 3) DB init in app/db/mongo.py registers all Document models. 4) Config uses pydantic-settings with Optional fields. 5) Tests use httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport, mock external services. 6) Redis is Upstash HTTP-based (upstash_redis.asyncio). 7) Vertex AI client uses httpx for API calls with circuit breaker.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/models/ - Beanie models, apps/backend/app/services/ai/ - AI clients (vertex, sarvam, cloudflare, embedder, router), apps/backend/app/services/ - business logic services, apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - FastAPI routers, apps/backend/app/db/ - MongoDB/Redis init, apps/backend/tests/ - pytest tests, apps/backend/scripts/ - admin scripts
